_comment: Neutral stand-in for the Oct 17 incident: a sell-then-buy-back request whose progress said the sale was being placed and whose final result was a failure, and a follow-up that depends on this call's own conversation. No real call, account, balance or personal phrasing.

requests.text: I want to sell one dollar of my SpaceX stock.
requests.result: To confirm: sell $1 of your SpaceX stock for cash at market price. Should I run it?

requests.text: Yes. And once that's done, buy it right back.
requests.partial: The sale of about $1.00 of SpaceX was being placed.
requests.result: The SpaceX sale didn't go through, and nothing was sold. SpaceX matched more than one stock product, so I didn't pick one. I haven't started the buy-back either, since it depends on the sale. Your SpaceX stock and cash are unchanged.

fragments.text: Do you have a good tip for keeping a basil plant alive?
Give it six hours of sun and water when the top of the soil is dry.
I keep it on a windowsill in the kitchen.
That works if the window faces south. Pinch off flower buds so it keeps growing leaves.
